title: The First Quantum Computer to Run in Space
description:
A University of Vienna-led team ran a shoebox-sized photonic quantum processor on a small satellite about 550 km up, launched in June 2025.
Despite losing half its detectors and a dimming laser, it made, steered and interfered pairs of photons over eight months (reported in a Sept 2026 arXiv preprint, not yet peer reviewed).
